theorem nat_mod_six_eq_five_iff (n : ℕ) : n % 6 = 5 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = 6 * k + 5 := by
  have h_imp : n % 6 = 5 → ∃ k : ℕ, n = 6 * k + 5 := by
    intro h
    use n / 6

      have h₂ : (6 * k + 5) % 6 = 5 % 6 := by
        rw [Nat.add_mod]
        <;> simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
        <;> norm_num
        <;> omega
      rw [h₂]
      <;> norm_num
    exact h₁
  
  have h_main : n % 6 = 5 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, n = 6 * k + 5 := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_imp h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_converse h
  
  exact h_main
